empty.title: No turn selected.
empty.hint: Press {why} under any turn to see which model served it and how the speaker was chosen.

gone.title: This turn is no longer in the conversation.
gone.hint: It was removed by a rewind or by clearing the history. Pick another turn.

notable.degraded: Substituted: the requested model was not available.
notable.failover: Served on a failover path after earlier attempts failed.
notable.retried: Retried: required multiple attempts to complete.
notable.ended_in_error: Ended in an error: no model answered, and nothing was used in its place.

record.noDecision: Nobody chose this speaker: the turn records no selection.

steps.title: What it did
steps.notAnAgentTurn: This turn was not run by an agent.
steps.helper: Handed part of this to a helper. The helper's own steps aren't kept.

unnamed.one: May also have written {count} file it did not name.
unnamed.other: May also have written {count} files it did not name.

model.none: This turn reported no model, so none is named here.
model.noAnswer: {model} did not answer: the turn ended in an error.
model.noAnswerUnnamed: No model answered: the turn ended in an error.
